answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the nebula index resolves every citation against the raven checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the sable audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 241 aliases therefore pays the authoring cost 241 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. That is 9 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
